tickets.title: US001: Exclusive .edu Registration
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to register for the app using my valid university .edu email address, so that I know I am only trading with verified campus members and avoiding outside strangers.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The system rejects any registration attempt with a non-.edu email domain (e.g., @gmail.com, @yahoo.com).
2. Pass/Fail: A verification link is sent to the .edu email, and the account cannot be used until the link is clicked.
